title: Runtime product insights
description: Runtime product facets P1–P12: kernels, memory, parameters, formats, model size, hosts, callers, releases, stages, viewer, jobs and plugin usage (Runtime Observability Blueprint, package.md §11). Product panels never page.

list.name: app
list.label: Application
list.description: Local default matches unlabeled series. Hosted provisioning binds this to exactly one application.

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: Runtime telemetry is recorded by the API's ingest route. A constant, so Loki selectors stay exactly service_name=~"$service", which Tau Cloud rewrites per environment.

list.name: population
list.label: Population
list.description: Signed-in by default (AR-W4-07): forged signed-out traffic can inflate only the signed-out series. Panels on metrics without a population label say so.

panels.title: Attempts by Kernel (daily)
panels.description: §11 panel 1. Completed evaluate, render and export attempts per kernel: the popularity denominator. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Kernel Share
panels.description: §11 panel 2. Share of completed evaluate, render and export attempts over the dashboard range. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Estimated Users per Kernel, Today
panels.description: §11 panel 3. Distinct signed-in principals with an attempt on each kernel today; the Runtime operations dashboard shows the _ALL fleet total. Population: signed-in only, by construction; signed-out users are not counted (unavailable by design). HyperLogLog, ±0.81 %, read with max across Machines, never summed.

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Users Who Met a Failure, per Kernel
panels.description: §11 panel 4. The failed set is a subset of any and is read on its own, never added to it. Population: signed-in only, by construction; signed-out users are not counted (unavailable by design). HyperLogLog, ±0.81 %, read with max across Machines, never summed.

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Kernel Heap p50 / p95 by Kernel and Source
panels.description: §11 panel 5. Memory at settle of successful attempts: kernel = WASM linear memory, child = a native kernel's worker process tree resident set, resident = a dedicated kernel process. Attempts without a reading (none) write no bucket. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Heap Coverage per Kernel
panels.description: §11 panel 5a. Share of completed attempts of every operation with a heap reading, by source. A kernel at 0 % has no row: compare with panel 1. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

targets.expr: clamp_max(sum by (kernel_id, tau_runtime_heap_source) (increase(tau_runtime_kernel_heap_count{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service",tau_runtime_population=~"$population"}[$__range])) / ignoring(tau_runtime_heap_source) group_left sum by (kernel_id) (increase(tau_runtime_operations_total{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service",tau_runtime_outcome!~"superseded|cancelled|abandoned",tau_runtime_population=~"$population"}[$__range])), 1)

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Heap of Failed Attempts
panels.description: §11 panel 5b. p95 memory at the moment of failure: the number OOM triage needs. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Heap by Device Class
panels.description: §11 panel 6. p95 heap on constrained vs standard devices (browsers and the desktop renderer). Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Heap Distribution, Selected Kernel
panels.description: §11 panel 7. Heap buckets over time for the Kernel variable. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Parameters Declared per Model
panels.description: §11 panel 8. Parameter leaves per succeeded evaluate, buckets 0…100 (cumulative, le). Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Models with Any Parameters, by Kernel
panels.description: §11 panel 9. Share of succeeded evaluates whose model declares at least one parameter. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Share of Parameterised Evaluates with Modified Defaults
panels.description: §11 panel 11. How often parameters are changed from their defaults, over evaluates of models that declare any. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Evaluates by Parameter Class (daily)
panels.description: §11 panel 10. none (0 declared), default (0 modified), some (< 50 %), most (< 100 %), all. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Parameter Features by Kernel
panels.description: §11 panel 37. Share of succeeded evaluates whose manifest uses units, arrays, decimals or structured values. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

targets.expr: sum by (kernel_id, tau_runtime_parameter_feature) (increase(tau_runtime_parameter_features_total{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service",tau_runtime_population=~"$population"}[$__range])) / ignoring(tau_runtime_parameter_feature) group_left sum by (kernel_id) (increase(tau_runtime_parameters_declared_count{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service",tau_runtime_population=~"$population"}[$__range]))

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Exports by Format (daily)

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Export Failure Rate by Format
panels.description: §11 panel 13. Failed / completed exports per format, for formats with at least 20 completed exports in the range. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Conversions: Source → Target
panels.description: §11 panel 35. Completed conversions per registry edge (A) and their failure rate (B); conversions off a registry edge read _OTHER. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

targets.expr: sum by (tau_runtime_source_format, tau_runtime_format) (increase(tau_runtime_transcode_formats_total{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service",tau_runtime_failed="true",tau_runtime_population=~"$population"}[$__range])) / sum by (tau_runtime_source_format, tau_runtime_format) (increase(tau_runtime_transcode_formats_total{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service",tau_runtime_population=~"$population"}[$__range]))

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Entry Formats by Kernel
panels.description: §11 panel 35. Completed evaluates by entry file format (py, cs, kcl, scad, ts, step, stl, 3dm, …). Evaluates are edit-weighted: an editing session evaluates many times, so this is not documents opened. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

panels.title: Platform Mix — sample: non-success attempts only
panels.description: §11 panel 19a. A sample, not a mix of all attempts: the runtime.operation Loki event is written only for non-success outcomes and capacity issues (package.md §1.6), so this is the platform mix of attempts that failed or were refused. Panel 36 has the counts for every completed attempt. Population: all populations recorded.

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.description: §11 panel 19a. panels.title: Release Cohorts: Render p95 by Kernel and Release
panels.description: §11 panel 23. Succeeded renders by admitted client release; _OTHER is hidden. Population: all populations recorded (release cohorts are bounded by release admission, not by population).

panels.title: Success Rate by Release
panels.description: §11 panel 24. The by-release counter counts completed attempts only, so merged outcomes never enter the denominator. Population: all populations recorded (this metric has no population label).

panels.title: Stage Breakdown: Render p95 per Phase
panels.description: §11 panel 25. prepare, resolve, compute, mesh, export, reuse, other (the generated span map); middleware self-time is panel 26, never inside a phase. Succeeded attempts only. Population: all populations recorded (this metric has no population label).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Middleware Share of Operation Time
panels.description: §11 panel 26. Middleware time is first-class and never attributed to the kernel. Population: all populations recorded (this metric has no population label).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Slowest Middleware
panels.description: §11 panel 26. Middleware ids by time spent; third-party ids are _OTHER. Population: all populations recorded (this metric has no population label).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Adaptation Rate by Kernel and Code
panels.description: §11 panel 27. The share of successes reached through a fallback, clamp or downgrade; a kernel whose successes are mostly adaptations is not healthy. Population: all populations recorded (this metric has no population label).

targets.expr: sum by (kernel_id, error_type) (increase(tau_runtime_adaptations_total{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service"}[$__range])) / ignoring(error_type) group_left sum by (kernel_id) (increase(tau_runtime_operations_total{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service",tau_runtime_outcome="succeeded",tau_runtime_population=~".*"}[$__range]))

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.description: §11 panel 29. Geometry receipt to first presented frame. Population: all populations recorded (this metric has no population label).

panels.title: Jobs by Outcome (daily)

panels.description: §11 panel 29. Passed / selected GeoSpec tests. Population: all populations recorded (this metric has no population label).

panels.title: Transcoder Usage (daily)
panels.description: §11 panel 30. Completed uses of each transcoder (assimp, gltf, image, svg-image, slicer); operation separates direct transcodes from the transcoder hop of an export. A transcoder unused in the range has no series. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Transcoder Failure Rate
panels.description: §11 panel 30. Failed / completed uses per transcoder, hard failures included (the client stamps the transcoder). Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Job Usage by Provider (daily)
panels.description: §11 panel 31. Terminal states per job provider, so each job is counted once. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Jobs Entering Attention by Provider (daily)
panels.description: §11 panel 31. Jobs that entered attention_required, from their own counter, once per job. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Middleware Usage
panels.description: §11 panel 32. Uses per middleware by operation (file parameters show as ParameterFileResolver use). Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Middleware Share of Joined Attempts
panels.description: §11 panel 32. The denominator is attempts with joined worker facts in which any middleware ran (one middleware histogram sample per such attempt, all populations); attempts without joined facts are on tau_runtime_facts_missing_total. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

targets.expr: sum by (tau_runtime_plugin, tau_runtime_operation) (increase(tau_runtime_plugin_operations_total{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service",tau_runtime_capability="middleware",tau_runtime_population=~"$population"}[$__range])) / ignoring(tau_runtime_plugin) group_left sum by (tau_runtime_operation) (increase(tau_runtime_middleware_duration_count{app=~"$app",service_name=~"$service"}[$__range]))

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Bundler Usage (daily)
panels.description: §11 panel 33. Bundles that ran (esbuild, rolldown); per-entry cache hits are not a use. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Machine Operations by Provider and Kind
panels.description: §11 panel 34. New operations by provider and kind: action, stop, hold, transfer (a print or cut sent), start (a job started). Node machine hosts only; no machine identity. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Machine Actions by Family
panels.description: §11 panel 34. Action operations by standard action family (provider extensions are _OTHER). Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Machine Outcomes by Provider
panels.description: §11 panel 34. Outcome mix of new machine operations. Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Machine Operations: Person vs Agent
panels.description: §11 panel 34. editor = a person, agent = an agent action (counted when it runs, after any approval). Population: the Population variable (default signed-in).

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health

panels.title: Plugin Reach, Today
panels.description: §11 panel 40. Distinct signed-in users per transcoder, job provider, machine provider, middleware and bundler today, with the failed set beside it. Population: signed-in only, by construction; signed-out users are not counted (unavailable by design). HyperLogLog, ±0.81 %, read with max across Machines, never summed.

defaults.noValue: no runtime telemetry recorded in this window; see Runtime operations → Telemetry health
